summary.en: A dated memo records unusual-light reports. It does not, by itself, identify an extraterrestrial cause.
summary.ko: A dated memo records unusual-light reports. It does not, by itself, identify an extraterrestrial cause.

body.en: The Halt memorandum records observations and reports. A record of observation is not by itself an identification of cause.
body.ko: The Halt memorandum records observations and reports. A record of observation is not by itself an identification of cause.

body.en: The lighthouse, radiation and later binary-code claims require separate evidence and separate limits.
body.ko: The lighthouse, radiation and later binary-code claims require separate evidence and separate limits.

statusQualifier.en: Limited to the content of the public document copy
statusQualifier.ko: Limited to the content of the public document copy

text.en: A memo dated 13 January 1981 under Halt's name records reports of unusual lights.
text.ko: A memo dated 13 January 1981 under Halt's name records reports of unusual lights.

reason.en: The observation recorded by the document is separated from an interpretation of the phenomenon; the copy's full chain of custody remains unverified.
reason.ko: The observation recorded by the document is separated from an interpretation of the phenomenon; the copy's full chain of custody remains unverified.

sourceType.en: Contemporary agency document - third-party public copy
sourceType.ko: Contemporary agency document - third-party public copy

whatItEstablishes.en: The report appears in the document.
whatItEstablishes.ko: The report appears in the document.

whatItDoesNotEstablish.en: Independent verification of every sentence, an extraterrestrial origin, or that Halt directly witnessed the first-night events.
whatItDoesNotEstablish.ko: Independent verification of every sentence, an extraterrestrial origin, or that Halt directly witnessed the first-night events.

counterEvidence.en: Paragraph 1 summarizes other people's reports; Halt's participation and observation scope are described separately later.
counterEvidence.ko: Paragraph 1 summarizes other people's reports; Halt's participation and observation scope are described separately later.

changeHistory.en: Record created; not a new change to the document itself.
changeHistory.ko: Record created; not a new change to the document itself.

text.en: The memo independently proves an extraterrestrial spacecraft landing.
text.ko: The memo independently proves an extraterrestrial spacecraft landing.

reason.en: Witness seriousness or professional status cannot replace causal identification; unexplained details are not automatically evidence of an extraterrestrial cause.
reason.ko: Witness seriousness or professional status cannot replace causal identification; unexplained details are not automatically evidence of an extraterrestrial cause.

sourceType.en: Contemporary agency document - third-party public copy
sourceType.ko: Contemporary agency document - third-party public copy

whatItDoesNotEstablish.en: Independent analysis of extraterrestrial material, machinery, or biology.
whatItDoesNotEstablish.ko: Independent analysis of extraterrestrial material, machinery, or biology.

counterEvidence.en: Conventional explanations, including the lighthouse hypothesis, remain to be tested; they do not necessarily resolve every observation.
counterEvidence.ko: Conventional explanations, including the lighthouse hypothesis, remain to be tested; they do not necessarily resolve every observation.

changeHistory.en: No new verification of extraterrestrial origin was found within scope.
changeHistory.ko: No new verification of extraterrestrial origin was found within scope.

statusQualifier.en: Only as a claim about this specific memo
statusQualifier.ko: Only as a claim about this specific memo

text.en: Penniston's binary code is written in the 1981 Halt memo.
text.ko: Penniston's binary code is written in the 1981 Halt memo.

reason.en: Whether the specified document contains the code can be checked directly; a later ASCII decoding does not authenticate transmission or date.
reason.ko: Whether the specified document contains the code can be checked directly; a later ASCII decoding does not authenticate transmission or date.

sourceType.en: Document inspection - full body of the public copy

whatItEstablishes.ko: The specified memo does not contain a binary string or a report of receiving code.

whatItDoesNotEstablish.en: That no 1980 personal notebook existed anywhere, deliberate fabrication, or that extraterrestrial communication is impossible.
whatItDoesNotEstablish.ko: That no 1980 personal notebook existed anywhere, deliberate fabrication, or that extraterrestrial communication is impossible.

changeHistory.en: The code-release chronology was reused; the original notebook date was not newly established.

text.ko: Orford Ness lighthouse is a grounded explanation for some flashing-light observations.

whatItDoesNotEstablish.ko: That every night, observation point and object had the same cause.
